text: そんなん　いうても　ポケモン　もちきれへんやんけ！

structure.jp: そんなん　いうても
ポケモン　もちきれへんやんけ！
structure.en: you can't carry all the Pokémon, can you!

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: ても after a verb means 'even if'. いうても is the Kansai dialect form of いっても. そんなん　いうても = 'even if you say that'.

patterns.name: 〜きれない
patterns.explanation: きれない added to a verb means you cannot do all of it. へん is Kansai dialect for ない. もちきれへん = 'can't carry them all'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.explanation: やんけ is the rough Kansai dialect form of じゃないか, a pushy 'isn't it!'. もちきれへんやんけ = 'you can't carry them all, can you!'.
